name: Solve a solved cube
description: Confirms the default solved cube returns an empty solution without crashing.
expected: The app reports that the cube is already solved and does not show a fake move sequence.

name: Scramble and solve a cube
description: Verifies a generated scramble can be solved and produces a usable move list.
steps: Press Solve cube and wait for solver initialization if prompted
expected: A solution appears with move count, full algorithm, progress controls, and no error.

name: Step through and replay the solution
description: Checks the solution can be followed manually and through autoplay.
steps: Generate and solve a random scramble
Press Replay after the final move
expected: The current move and progress update correctly; autoplay can be paused and replayed.

name: Camera scan and rotate the 3D cube preview
description: Checks the camera scanner exposes permission feedback and the cube preview has rotation controls.
steps: Open TwistLab on a camera-capable secure browser
Tap Open camera and allow access if prompted
Choose the face shown in the preview
Capture 9 sticker colors and review the sticker net
Use the left and right rotate controls
expected: The selected face is updated with sampled colors, a review reminder appears, camera failures are explained, and the 3D-style preview rotates.

name: Reject invalid sticker color counts
description: Confirms an edited cube with incorrect color counts is rejected with a visible explanation.
steps: Tap a non-center sticker to cycle its color
expected: A visible validation error explains each color must appear exactly nine times and no solution is shown.
